entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: The de facto state army of the Celestial Palatinate in the Edge, a dogmatic cause-mercenary free company of knights, squires and foot soldiers.

entities.name: Celestial Palatinate
entities.description: A stellar nation in the Edge whose state army is the Sunstar Free Company and which provides the Company's ships, weapons and holy sanction.

entities.name: The Edge
entities.description: The setting of the Edge of Eternities, home to stellar nations like the Celestial Palatinate.

entities.name: Regent Maximum
entities.description: The ruler of the Celestial Palatinate whose current favored regiment is the Sunstar Free Company.

entities.name: Summism
entities.description: The faith whose tenets the Sunstar Free Company serves.

entities.name: Cosmogrands
entities.description: Mighty lords of the Celestial Palatinate whose holdings Sunstar recruits from and whose aims it may serve.

entities.name: Sothera system
entities.description: The system where the Sunstar Free Company operates, with Adagia as its main location.

entities.name: Adagia
entities.description: The main location of the Sunstar Free Company's operations in the Sothera system.

entities.name: Dawnsire
entities.description: Sunstar's largest battlecruiser in the Sothera system.

entities.name: Candela
entities.description: A shieldship and flying city that escorts Dawnsire.

entities.name: Solar Knights
entities.description: Sunstar knights who command soldiers and ships within the Free Company.

entities.name: Photophoroi
entities.description: The Free Company's regular foot soldiers, grouped into lances.

entities.name: Tabor mechans
entities.description: Squad-level utility mechan units that support the photophoroi.

entities.name: Incaglas
entities.description: A power source and conduit embedded in all Sunstar machinery that can replace one's nerves.

relations.quote: The Sunstar Free Company is the de facto state army of the Celestial Palatinate in the Edge .

relations.note: favored regiment of the Regent Maximum
relations.quote: the Sunstar Free Company is the current favored regiment of the Regent Maximum
It is escorted by Candela , a shieldship and flying city.
They are supported by tabor mechans , squad-level utility units.
